objectTypes.name: Repeater
objectTypes.desc: Create repeated copies of one or more 3D objects.

objectClasses.name: Repeater
objectClasses.description: Copies source objects by a fixed transform step.

objectClasses.name: Linear Repeater
objectClasses.description: Copies source objects evenly between the first and last transform.

objectClasses.name: Random Repeater
objectClasses.description: Copies source objects with deterministic random transforms inside ranges.
